title: Rotate Image
keyIdea: Rotating 90° clockwise sends [i][j] to [j][n − 1 − i]. Do it in two in-place steps: transpose ([i][j] ↔ [j][i], only above the diagonal) and then reverse every row.

approaches.name: Transpose, then reverse rows
approaches.idea: Your code: swap matrix[i][j] with matrix[j][i] for j > i, then reverse each row.
approaches.why: Each cell is touched a constant number of times; everything is in place.

quiz.q: Why does the inner loop start at j = i + 1?
options: Each pair is swapped once; swapping it twice would undo the transpose
To avoid going out of bounds
It is faster but not needed

quiz.q: Where does matrix[i][j] end up after a clockwise rotation?
How would you rotate counter-clockwise instead?
options: Transpose, then reverse every column (or reverse rows first, then transpose)
